description: Defines the StateManager9 class for caching and managing Direct3D 9 rendering states, including state structures, methods for setting and updating states, and internal state tracking variables.

classes.name: StateManager9
classes.description: A class for managing and caching Direct3D 9 rendering states, ensuring efficient state changes and consistency.

methods.name: syncState
methods.description: Synchronizes the internal state with the provided GL state and dirty bits.

methods.name: setBlendDepthRasterStates
methods.description: Sets blend, depth, and rasterizer states based on GL state.

methods.name: setScissorState
methods.description: Configures scissor rectangle and enable state.

methods.name: setViewportState
methods.description: Sets viewport parameters including rectangle, depth range, draw mode, and front face.

methods.name: forceSetDepthStencilState
methods.description: Forcibly sets the depth and stencil state.

methods.name: updateDepthSizeIfChanged
methods.description: Updates depth buffer size if changed.

methods.name: updateStencilSizeIfChanged
methods.description: Updates stencil buffer size if changed.

methods.name: setRenderTargetBounds
methods.description: Sets the bounds of the render target.
